title: energy.model_events event (model selection / adaptation transitions)
description: Published when dynamic model selection triggers a model switch, re-evaluation, or retrain.

run_id.description: One id per experiment run, shared across all topics.

event_time.description: Event-time at which the model decision took effect (UTC).

previous_model.description: Model before transition, or null if initial selection.

trigger_metric.description: Identifier of the metric or signal causing the switch (e.g. 'utility_score', 'mae_threshold', 'latency_spike', 'drift_signal', 'scheduled').

trigger_value.description: Value of the triggering metric at decision time.

metrics.description: Snapshot of selection metrics (utility scores, MAE, latency, etc.).

trigger_event_id.description: Upstream event_id that prompted the evaluation, if applicable.

trigger_replay_time_ms.description: replay_time_ms of the upstream trigger event, if applicable.

emit_time_ms.description: Wall-clock epoch-ms when this event was emitted.
